subject_baseline.paradigm: Full-Image Two-Stage Detector-Based Siamese Tracker (Swin-Tiny + 5-level FPN + DS-RPN + VR-CNN + 11-Proposal Linear Background Subtraction + Single-State EMA Template Update)

structural_characteristics_and_weakness_.fact: Searches the entire image every frame via RPN (1000 proposals -> Top-5 truncation) on FPN strides [4, 8, 16, 32, 64] with 7x7 RoIAlign.
structural_characteristics_and_weakness_.weakness_hypothesis: Lacks local high-resolution focusing for tiny targets (<16px) and is vulnerable to full-image far-away thermal distractors.

structural_characteristics_and_weakness_.fact: Maintains only a single running-average template _bbox_feats_z (lr=0.01), gated solely by current-frame tra_bboxes[0]+det_bboxes[0]>1.9 and IoU>0.8 before background re-ranking.
structural_characteristics_and_weakness_.weakness_hypothesis: Lacks multi-frame memory bank, motion-consistency gating, and rollback capability when template or background state degrades.

structural_characteristics_and_weakness_.fact: Samples 11 RPN proposals with IoU<=0 from the query/update frame into _bbox_feats_bg, subtracts max matching score from Top-5, and overwrites all 11 background features on every update.
structural_characteristics_and_weakness_.weakness_hypothesis: Does not persistently anchor hard local confusers/distractors and fails when uncertain/occluded frames trigger updates.

structural_characteristics_and_weakness_.fact: Zero explicit motion model (no Kalman filter, no nonlinear trajectory predictor, no optical-flow GMC, no drift-detection/recovery state machine).
structural_characteristics_and_weakness_.weakness_hypothesis: Once hijacked by a background thermal hotspot or after fast nonlinear UAV maneuvers, suffers long-horizon irreversible drift (e.g., 101+ frame zero-overlap episodes account for 60.1% of zero-IoU loss on val90).

structural_characteristics_and_weakness_.fact: Always outputs a dense 4D box (never predicts target absence) and relies on discrete 7x7 RoI cross-correlation rather than continuous video-level hidden states.
structural_characteristics_and_weakness_.weakness_hypothesis: Loses all 2088 absent frames on val90 (1.76pp macro SA loss) and degrades under continuous low-contrast/occlusion sequences.

core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.technical_route: One-Stream ViT (DropMAE) + Self-Adaptive Local Sampling (Confidence-Driven Dynamic Search Factor Scaling)
core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.main_differences_from_siamdt: Replaces SiamDT's fixed full-image RPN search with a local search crop whose Search Factor (SF) dynamically expands when tracking confidence drops and contracts to focus on tiny targets when stable.
core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.open_source_status: Verified HTTP 200 (https://github.com/vero1925/FocusTrack); complete source tree (lib, tracking, experiments, annos).
core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.weights_status: Verified Available (Google Drive & Baidu Netdisk pwd: 1106); includes FocusTrack single/stage2 weights AND Anti-UAV410-retrained weights for OSTrack, ROMTrack, ZoomTrack, DropTrack.
core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.fair_reproduction_and_alignment: Yes (Group I: In-Domain Anti-UAV410 Trained). Uses identical Anti-UAV410 splits and can output per-frame bbox + confidence score.
core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.complementary_diagnostic_axis: A1_Search_Scope_and_Resolution (Local Dynamic Search Factor vs. Full-Image Fixed RPN)
core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.why_core_pool: Directly tests whether SiamDT's failures on tiny targets and far-field thermal clutter are rescued by self-adaptive local sampling, while providing 4 bonus retrained local-tracker baselines in the same codebase.

core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.technical_route: Frozen DINOv2 ViT + LoRA PEFT + Gated FIFO Memory Bank + Kalman Motion-Consistency Update Gate + Motion-Aware Memory Attention Layer (MAL)
core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.main_differences_from_siamdt: Replaces SiamDT's Swin-T/FPN + single EMA template with a frozen foundation backbone (DINOv2+LoRA) and a multi-frame FIFO memory bank protected by both classification confidence and Kalman-filter motion consistency checks.
core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.open_source_status: Verified HTTP 200 (https://github.com/SeoulTech-HCIRLab/MemLoTrack); complete trackit codebase with dedicated Anti-UAV410 config.
core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.weights_status: Verified Available (Google Drive); provides both antiuav410_retrained_weight.bin (SOT pretrained + Anti-UAV410 fine-tuned) and antiuav410_scratch_weight.bin (Anti-UAV410 only).
core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.fair_reproduction_and_alignment: Yes (Group I: In-Domain Anti-UAV410 Trained, with both scratch and retrained checkpoints for controlled comparison).
core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.complementary_diagnostic_axis: A2_Temporal_Memory_and_Update_Gate (Kalman-Gated Multi-Frame Memory Attention vs. Ungated Single-State EMA)
core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.why_core_pool: Directly tests whether motion-consistency-gated FIFO memory + MAL rescues SiamDT's template degradation and drift episodes, while allowing strict separation of backbone pretraining (retrained vs. scratch).

core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.technical_route: SAM 2.1 Foundation Tracker + Distractor-Aware Memory (Decoupled Recent Appearance Memory RAM & Distractor-Resolving Memory DRM) + Introspective Mask-Uncertainty Update Freezing
core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.main_differences_from_siamdt: Replaces SiamDT's 11 random non-target RPN proposals (_bbox_feats_bg overwritten on every update) with an explicit Distractor-Resolving Memory (DRM) that anchors hard confusers and freezes memory updates whenever output mask geometry/area exhibits multi-peak uncertainty.
core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.open_source_status: Verified HTTP 200 (https://github.com/jovanavidenovic/DAM4SAM); complete source with run_on_box_dataset.py for bounding-box benchmarks.
core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.weights_status: Verified Available (Official SAM 2.1 checkpoints via download script; training-free memory mechanism).
core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.fair_reproduction_and_alignment: Yes (Group II: Zero-Shot Box-Initialized Foundation Model). Evaluates on identical frames with first-frame GT box initialization.
core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.complementary_diagnostic_axis: A3_Background_Distractor_Suppression (Persistent Distractor-Resolving Memory + Uncertainty Freeze vs. 11-Proposal Linear Subtraction)
core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.why_core_pool: Serves as the sharpest mechanism probe for diagnosing why SiamDT's background suppression fails under thermal crossovers, similar-looking background hotspots, and partial occlusion.

core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.technical_route: SAM 2.1 + Higher-Order Markov Nonlinear Motion Predictor (MP) + Error Detection–Recovery Module (EDRM) + Target-Aware Memory Bank (TAMB)
core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.main_differences_from_siamdt: Adds explicit nonlinear trajectory dynamics (MP) and an explicit Error Detection–Recovery state machine (EDRM) that detects semantic/geometric shifts and triggers recovery, whereas SiamDT has zero motion model and suffers permanent drift once locked onto clutter.
core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.open_source_status: Verified HTTP 200 (https://github.com/DurYi/SAMOSA and https://github.com/yangchris11/samurai); complete source code.
core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.weights_status: Verified Available (Motion Predictor checkpoint sam2/checkpoints/mp.pth is committed directly inside the GitHub repo + official SAM 2.1 checkpoints).
core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.fair_reproduction_and_alignment: Yes (Group II: Visual Zero-Shot + BBox-Trajectory-Trained Motion Prior). Specifically validated on Anti-UAV nonlinear motion scenarios.
core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.complementary_diagnostic_axis: A4_Motion_Modeling_and_Recovery (Nonlinear Motion Predictor + Error Recovery vs. Memoryless Full-Image RPN)
core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.why_core_pool: Directly targets SiamDT's #1 failure budget item on val90 (the 101+ frame long-horizon zero-IoU drift episodes caused by fast maneuvers, camera shake, and failed re-acquisition).

core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.technical_route: MCITrack: Mamba Hidden-State Video-Level Contextual Propagation; UETrack: Unified 5-Modality (incl. Thermal) Token-Pooling Mixture-of-Experts (TP-MoE) + Target-Aware Adaptive Distillation
core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.main_differences_from_siamdt: MCITrack propagates continuous video-level context through Mamba hidden states across backbone layers rather than discrete 7x7 RoI correlation; UETrack routes thermal/degraded tokens dynamically via similarity-driven Mixture-of-Experts.
core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.open_source_status: Verified HTTP 200 (https://github.com/kangben258/UETrack and https://github.com/kangben258/MCITrack); complete PyTracking/OSTrack-style codebase.
core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.weights_status: Verified Available (HuggingFace kangben258/UETrack and Google Drive for MCITrack).
core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.fair_reproduction_and_alignment: Yes (Group II: Cross-Domain SOT / Thermal-Unified Pretrained; also supports fine-tuning if required later).
core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.complementary_diagnostic_axis: A5_Continuous_Context_and_Thermal_Representation (Mamba Hidden-State Context & MoE Routing vs. Discrete RoI Correlation)
core_experimental_pool_batch1_recommende.why_core_pool: Tests whether continuous state-space context propagation (MCITrack) and adaptive expert routing (UETrack) rescue SiamDT during gradual thermal contrast decay and scale changes.
